name: Sarvam AI
description: India's homegrown LLM stack with Rs 100 of credits that never expire.
overview: Sarvam AI builds India's sovereign model stack, and every verified account starts with Rs 100 of free credits on the dashboard — roughly $1.15, usable on any API, and the credits never expire. The chat side runs on Token Factory: Sarvam 105B at 128K context plus open-weight GLM-5.3, GLM-5.3 Flash, Gemma 4 31B, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and Kimi K3.1 Pro behind an OpenAI-compatible /v2 endpoint with native Indic language coverage across ten Indian languages plus English. Speech, translation and document models share the same key and balance.
free_access: Rs 100 free credits on signup, never expire
Sarvam 105B plus GLM, DeepSeek, Gemma and Kimi on /v2
Native coverage of 10 Indian languages and English
No card needed; 60 requests/minute on starter limits
notes: Credits are a one-off rupee balance, not a renewing quota; calls return 402 once it is spent. DeepSeek V4 Pro and Kimi K3.1 Pro need provisioned throughput.
